name: Easy Slow Cooker Ramen with Tofu, Bok Choy, Carrots & Mushrooms

ingredients.name: instant ramen noodle soup, soy sauce flavor

instructions.primary_message: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Place water, gochujang, soy sauce, and seasoning packets from the ramen noodles in a 4-quart slow cooker insert, then stir to combine the broth. (Reserve noodles for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
6 cups water
2 tbsp gochujang
1 tbsp soy sauce
3 (85 g) pkg instant ramen noodle soup, soy sauce flavor

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 baby bok choy
3 stick celery
1 small bunch green onion (scallion)

instructions.primary_message: Trim and cut bok choy crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the slow cooker with the broth.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, large dice tofu.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add tofu and cook, stirring occasionally, until browned, 4-5 minutes. Add garlic and ginger to the skillet; continue to cook, stirring often, until fragrant, about 1 minute. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp neutral vegetable oil
2 tbsp minced garlic
1 tbsp minced ginger

instructions.primary_message: While the tofu is cooking, trim and medium dice celery. Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add both to the slow cooker, along with mushrooms and carrots.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (227 g) pkg sliced white mushrooms
½ (283 g) bag shredded carrots

instructions.primary_message: Add cooked tofu to the slow cooker and gently stir to combine. Cover and cook until veggies are tender, 5 hours on LOW or 3 hours on HIGH.
When the soup is done, add reserved noodles, nestling them into the broth. Continue to cook until noodles are tender, about 5 minutes on HIGH. Stir to combine and remove from heat.
To serve, divide soup between bowls and enjoy!
